requirements.text: Have 7+ years of experience building high-scale consumer product experiences, creative systems, ads systems, or platform infrastructure.
Have a track record of architecting and delivering complex systems that power user-facing experiences across multiple surfaces.
Are comfortable working at the intersection of frontend systems, backend infrastructure, design, and product strategy.
Bring strong product intuition and enjoy collaborating deeply with Product, Design, and Research.
Thrive in 0→1 environments where systems, architecture, and user experiences must be defined from scratch.
Communicate clearly, think holistically, and make decisions rooted in both user needs and long-term sustainability.
Are motivated by building privacy-preserving, safe, and user-first monetization systems.
Bonus: Have experience with ads formats, creative rendering systems, content delivery, design systems, media platforms, or interactive product experiences.
This role is exclusively based in our San Francisco HQ. We offer relocation assistance to new employees.
